commits.edited_message:
Tighter Huffman mapping trigger

Also drop the indirection table when compaction saves only a few groups:
the per-pixel dereference then costs more than the handful of
HTreeGroup slots it avoids.

Bug: 550179426

Change-Id: I248e093488cd44f6a13052b4461c7e067810a93a

reject truncated Huffman-table streams before allocating

Each Huffman group has 5 trees, each requiring at least 4 bits in the
bitstream (20 bits per group). Verify that the remaining unread bits in
dec->br can cover num_htree_groups_max before allocating code_lengths,
htree_groups, and huffman_tables.

Also drop the first of the preceding checks: mapping is only NULL after
the mapping table was folded back, which resets num_htree_groups to
num_htree_groups_max, so mapping == NULL implies the two counts are
equal and the condition can never trigger.

BUG: 550179426
Change-Id: I87d884bd216f47789b76ac875018a19fc674dd4f

coupling:
The two commits maintain opposite halves of one invariant linking ReadHuffmanCodes() and ReadHuffmanCodesHelper() in src/dec/vp8l_dec.c: huffman-table groups are indexed either through the compaction 'mapping' table (indices in [0, num_htree_groups)) or directly by identity (mapping == NULL, indices in [0, num_htree_groups_max)), and the HTreeGroup array is sized with the smaller of the two.
97eb6d7 ('Tighter Huffman mapping trigger') owns the fold-back that drops the mapping table. Its edit widens the fold from 'num == max' to 'max - num < 4' and drops the 'num_htree_groups = num_htree_groups_max' re-sync, so mapping can now be NULL while num_htree_groups < num_htree_groups_max. Read alone this is benign: the entry check in ReadHuffmanCodesHelper (mapping == NULL && num != max -> Error) turns the inconsistency into a clean bitstream error; nothing is over-indexed.
b2f81b5 ('reject truncated Huffman-table streams before allocating') owns the code directly below that check. Its edit removes the check's first clause as redundant, with a commit message citing the invariant the first commit just broke ('mapping is only NULL after the mapping table was folded back, which resets num_htree_groups to num_htree_groups_max'). Read alone this is also benign: with the real fold-back the clause truly cannot trigger.
Composed, ReadHuffmanCodesHelper iterates i < num_htree_groups_max while indexing htree_groups[i] into an array allocated by VP8LHtreeGroupsNew(num_htree_groups): a meta-Huffman image whose group indices are dense enough to fold (max - num in [1,3]) yet not identical, with max > 200 so the compaction path runs, writes HTreeGroup fields past the end of the allocation during header parsing (heap-buffer-overflow WRITE, CWE-787, reachable from WebPDecodeRGBA on a well-formed VP8L stream).
A repair cannot be produced or validated from either diff in isolation: restoring the entry check at b2f81b5 only guards the streams that the 97eb6d7 fold-back now mismatches, and repairing the fold-back at 97eb6d7 (re-syncing the counts or sizing the array for identity indexing) is only observable as necessary because b2f81b5 removed the error path that previously converted the mismatch into a clean failure. Each single-edit tree was verified to decode the PoC without any sanitizer error (edit A alone: stream rejected by the entry check; edit B alone: invariant holds), while the combined tree aborts; a real encoder-produced lossless file decodes identically (pixel checksum) on the original and combined trees.
